user_query: I want to enhance my website's SEO by analyzing keyword density and fetching sitemap information.

TaskList.description: Fetch the content of the About page from the provided URL.
Analyze the keyword density from the content retrieved in Subtask 1 and extract the top 15 keywords and phrases, sorted by density.
Fetch the sitemap XML for 'example.com' and convert it to JSON format, including meta information.
Compile the results from Subtask 2 and Subtask 3 into a comprehensive SEO report.
